scope: Independent campaign textures and textured presentation icons for squirrel and workflow-sdk
generationAuthorization: Owner authorized texture generation via Nano Banana (gemini-nano-banana-2.1) for squirrel and workflow-sdk on 2026-11-26.
acceptanceAuthorization: Exact-byte owner approval recorded for all four light and dark raw outputs on 2026-11-26.
publicationAuthorization: Owner authorized continuing full onboarding & publication workflow on 2026-11-26.

description.en: Oak and hazel leaves, slender twigs and empty acorn cups rest along the right margin of quiet matte mineral paper.
description.zh: 栎树与榛叶、细枝和空橡果壳托沿安静的矿物纸面右侧入画，与赤橙松鼠徽标的自然栖息地相呼应。

design.motif: Asymmetric gray-sage lobed oak leaves, hazel leaves, fine twigs and small empty acorn cups pressed along the right and lower-right margins.
design.rationale: Matches Squirrel's woodland oak and hazel cache habitat with right-margin composition and quiet left 62% typography space, distinct from other animal leaves.

purpose.en: Personal API key and token vault MCP server on Cloudflare Workers with OAuth 2.1 and Bot Bearer Tokens.
purpose.zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的个人级 API Key / Token 托管 MCP 服务，支持 OAuth 2.1 与无头 Bot Token。

description.en: Blind-embossed split-channel routing grooves, circular terminal seats and rotary detent arcs pressed across matte pressboard.
description.zh: 在全画幅哑光压纹纸板上压出分流双通道导槽、圆形终端座与旋转档位点弧线，呼应双内核切换工具。

design.motif: Full-square blind-embossed paired routing grooves, rounded bends, circular terminal-seat rings and rotary detent dot arcs pressed into matte pressboard.
design.rationale: Relates Workflow SDK's dual-kernel selector switch identity to a continuous tactile routing surface with distinct split-channel geometry.

purpose.en: TypeScript Workflow & Agent SDK with dual kernels: Antigravity (primary) and pure-TS Vercel AI SDK.
purpose.zh: 支持 Antigravity 与纯 TypeScript Vercel AI SDK 双内核的编排与智能体开发套件。
